# Steps: `jl-steps`

The steps of a process and where people are: done, current, and still to come.

- Class `JlSteps`, a molecule: `import { JlSteps } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/steps

The steps of a process and where people are in it. Each item is { label, description? }; current is
the index of the step people are on, from 0. Steps before it are done and show a check, the current one is in the
accent colour, the rest wait. current equal to the number of steps marks them all done.

clickable turns done steps into buttons: people go back to one, and change fires with its index. Narrower than 560
pixels, horizontal steps keep their markers and the current step's text.

## Use

```ts
import { JlSteps } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlSteps
  current={1}
  items={[{"label":"Cart","description":"3 items"},{"label":"Shipping","description":"Address and speed"},{"label":"Payment","description":"Card or invoice"},{"label":"Review"}]}
/>
```

```html
<jl-steps
  current="1"
  items='[{"label":"Cart","description":"3 items"},{"label":"Shipping","description":"Address and speed"},{"label":"Payment","description":"Card or invoice"},{"label":"Review"}]'
></jl-steps>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `StepItem[]`, default `[]`. The steps, in order: { label, description?, failed? }. A failed step (a payment refused, a transaction rolled back) shows an × in the danger colour.
- `current` (attribute `current`): `number`, default `0`. The index of the current step, from 0; the number of steps when all are done.
- `orientation` (attribute `orientation`): `'horizontal' | 'vertical'`, default `'horizontal'`. In a row, or in a column with the descriptions beside the markers.
- `clickable` (attribute `clickable`): `boolean`, default `false`. Done steps become buttons that go back to them.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The list’s name for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `number`: People went back to a done step; the detail is its index.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The ordered list of steps.
- `--marker` (custom property): The size of the round markers (28px).

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A failed step

A step that failed: the process stopped there, and says so.

```html
<jl-steps current="3" items='[{"label":"Received","description":"10:42:01"},{"label":"Planned","description":"10:42:03"},{"label":"Rolled back","description":"The package was refused","failed":true}]'></jl-steps>
```

### Horizontal

```html
<jl-steps current="2" items='[{"label":"Cart","description":"3 items"},{"label":"Shipping","description":"Address and speed"},{"label":"Payment","description":"Card or invoice"},{"label":"Review"}]'></jl-steps>
```

### Vertical

```html
<jl-steps orientation="vertical" current="1" items='[{"label":"Create your account","description":"Email and password"},{"label":"Invite your team","description":"Or do it later from Settings"},{"label":"Connect a repository","description":"GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket"},{"label":"Deploy","description":"Your first preview in a minute"}]' class="narrow"></jl-steps>
```

### Going back to a done step

Done steps are buttons that go back; the buttons below move forward.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-steps class="demo-steps" clickable current="2" items='[{"label":"Cart","description":"3 items"},{"label":"Shipping","description":"Address and speed"},{"label":"Payment","description":"Card or invoice"},{"label":"Review"}]'></jl-steps>
  <div class="row">
    <jl-button class="demo-back" icon="arrow-left" label="Back"></jl-button>
    <jl-button class="demo-next" variant="primary" icon-end="arrow-right" label="Continue"></jl-button>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
const steps = root.querySelector('jl-steps');
const move = (by) => steps.current.set((current) => Math.min(Math.max(current + by, 0), 4));
root.querySelector('.demo-back').events.register('press', () => move(-1));
root.querySelector('.demo-next').events.register('press', () => move(1));
```

### All done

```html
<jl-steps current="4" items='[{"label":"Upload"},{"label":"Check"},{"label":"Publish"},{"label":"Share"}]'></jl-steps>
```
